highlights.zh: 内置可充电灯光，强调展示和暗处可见效果；按是否含定位磁铁区分。
highlights.en: Rechargeable internal illumination emphasizes display and low-light visibility; positioning magnets are distinguished by version.

summary.zh: 发光机构增加电子元件和重量；没有将“能发光”视作竞速性能升级。
summary.en: Lighting adds electronic parts and weight; illumination itself is not treated as a speed-performance upgrade.

tradeoffs.zh: 发光与荧光贴纸不是同一种结构；电池和充电配件按来源页说明。
tradeoffs.en: Powered lighting differs from fluorescent stickers; batteries and charging accessories follow the source listing.

name.zh: 大雁 孤鸿 Pro M 三阶 54mm (磁悬浮)

note.zh: 此具体版本在 TheCubicle 商品页的 Added 上架日，不等同于全球首发日。
note.en: The Added listing date displayed for this exact version by TheCubicle; not a worldwide launch date.

note.zh: 此具体版本在美国商家的查询标价；不含运费、税费，非首发定价。

adjustment.zh: 5 档徒手弹力调节；轴距不能独立于弹力任意调节。
adjustment.en: Five hand-operated compression positions; center travel is not independently adjustable.

highlights.zh: 54 mm 尺寸；角轴磁力定位，磁悬浮替代弹簧。
highlights.en: 54 mm format with corner-to-core magnets and MagLev replacing springs.

summary.zh: 这一版强调紧凑的握持和轴磁稳定性；商家将磁悬浮版描述为更快的选择。
summary.en: This version combines a compact grip with core-magnetic stability; the retailer describes MagLev versions as the faster option.

tradeoffs.zh: 尺寸与弹力结构会改变握持和控制感；不能把 55 mm 标准版重量当作其他五款的重量。
tradeoffs.en: Size and return system affect grip and control; the 55 mm Standard weight does not describe the other five variants.
